support_claim: The packet links MER-55 to the name Meridian Energy Partners and billing to Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but provides no cross-reference or identifier that establishes they are the same legal counterparty.

critic.reason: The cited excerpts only show compatible name overlap between MER-55 and the billing name, with no shared identifier or explicit cross-reference, so they fail the contract's establishing-evidence bar for SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT and properly support UNRESOLVED.
